* ¼ [[Cookbook:Pound|pound]] (110 g) [[Cookbook:Chocolate|sweet chocolate]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] [[cookbook:Cream|cream]]
* [[Cookbook:Sift|sifted]] [[Cookbook:Powdered Sugar|confectioner's sugar]]

==Procedure==

# Melt chocolate over [[Cookbook:Water|hot water]].
# Add the cream.
# Gradually [[Cookbook:Beat|beat]] in sugar until [[Cookbook:Icing|icing]] is creamy and thick enough to spread.
